title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二十六章、太后的冷笑

    包拯和公孙策从冷宫出来，马上赶去太后那儿抓张怀。
    冷风中，太后的宫门口站着一排带刀侍卫。他们仿佛知道包拯要来，已经做好了准备。
    包拯心中一惊，连忙对公孙策说：“你去找卫宁，要他立刻去冷宫把蓝香保护起来！”担心还有问题，包拯又说：“还有城东的王铁，也要马上保护起来！要卫宁亲自去，现在宫里的任何人都不能相信。”
    公孙策看了看太后宫门口的侍卫，也明白了，吃惊地问道：“他们怎么知道我们要来？难道……有人跟着我们？”
    包拯点头说：“我们去了哪儿、见了什么人、说了什么话，他们可能都知道了。是我的错，应该想到这里是皇宫，是太后的家，宫里的每一个人都可能是太后的人。”
    “那蓝香有危险！我走了！你自己小心！”公孙策急匆匆地走了。
    公孙策刚走，太后的宫门口那边有了响动。一群宫女和太监扶着一个人走了出来，是太后。太后站在侍卫前面，远远地看着包拯，神情十分冷淡。张怀站在她旁边，轻轻扶着她的手。
    “包拯，你是来见我的吗？”太后问。
    包拯弯腰答道：“太后，我是来抓人的。太监总管张怀，犯了杀人放火的罪。”
    “他杀了什么人？放了什么火？”太后语气没有一点儿变化。
    “二十一年前，他放了冷宫的大火，杀了一名侍卫和数名宫女，以及一个刚出生的孩子。”
    “你有证据吗？”
    “我有人证。”
    “冷宫那个疯疯傻傻的宫女吗？你要用一个精神不正常的人来当证人？”
    包拯心中一惊，果然没有猜错。他和公孙策去冷宫见蓝香的时候，真的有人跟在后面。
    “看来您都知道了。那二十一年前的那天晚上发生了什么，您能和我说说吗？”包拯问。
    与昨天重提二十一年前旧事时的反应不一样，现在的太后神色安然，没有一点儿紧张。她冷笑道：“我没有话要对你说，但如果你是来抓张怀的，我可以告诉你，不行。”
    包拯拿出皇帝的令牌，高举到面前说：“对不起，今天我一定要带走张怀。”
    “是我的话重要，还是你手里那块铁牌重要？”太后冷笑道。
    “这是皇上的令牌！”包拯大声说。
    “是又怎么样……”太后冷笑，但她的话被一声“母亲”打断了，在包拯刚刚走来的那条路上，一个人正快步走来。他的身后也跟着一群宫女和太监，来人是皇帝。
fullText.traditional:
第二十六章、太后的冷笑

    包拯和公孫策從冷宮出來，馬上趕去太后那兒抓張懷。
    冷風中，太后的宮門口站著一排帶刀侍衛。他們彷彿知道包拯要來，已經做好了準備。
    包拯心中一驚，連忙對公孫策說：“你去找衛寧，要他立刻去冷宮把藍香保護起來！”擔心還有問題，包拯又說：“還有城東的王鐵，也要馬上保護起來！要衛寧親自去，現在宮裡的任何人都不能相信。”
    公孫策看了看太后宮門口的侍衛，也明白了，吃驚地問道：“他們怎麼知道我們要來？難道……有人跟著我們？”
    包拯點頭說：“我們去了哪兒、見了什麼人、說了什麼話，他們可能都知道了。是我的錯，應該想到這裡是皇宮，是太后的家，宮裡的每一個人都可能是太后的人。”
    “那藍香有危險！我走了！你自己小心！”公孫策急匆匆地走了。
    公孫策剛走，太后的宮門口那邊有了響動。一群宮女和太監扶著一個人走了出來，是太后。太后站在侍衛前面，遠遠地看著包拯，神情十分冷淡。張懷站在她旁邊，輕輕扶著她的手。
    “包拯，你是來見我的嗎？”太后問。
    包拯彎腰答道：“太后，我是來抓人的。太監總管張懷，犯了殺人放火的罪。”
    “他殺了什麼人？放了什麼火？”太后語氣沒有一點兒變化。
    “二十一年前，他放了冷宮的大火，殺了一名侍衛和數名宮女，以及一個剛出生的孩子。”
    “你有證據嗎？”
    “我有人證。”
    “冷宮那個瘋瘋傻傻的宮女嗎？你要用一個精神不正常的人來當證人？”
    包拯心中一驚，果然沒有猜錯。他和公孫策去冷宮見藍香的時候，真的有人跟在後面。
    “看來您都知道了。那二十一年前的那天晚上發生了什麼，您能和我說說嗎？”包拯問。
    與昨天重提二十一年前舊事時的反應不一樣，現在的太后神色安然，沒有一點兒緊張。她冷笑道：“我沒有話要對你說，但如果你是來抓張懷的，我可以告訴你，不行。”
    包拯拿出皇帝的令牌，高舉到面前說：“對不起，今天我一定要帶走張懷。”
    “是我的話重要，還是你手裡那塊鐵牌重要？”太后冷笑道。
    “這是皇上的令牌！”包拯大聲說。
    “是又怎麼樣……”太后冷笑，但她的話被一聲“母親”打斷了，在包拯剛剛走來的那條路上，一個人正快步走來。他的身後也跟著一群宮女和太監，來人是皇帝。

sentences.pinyin: shì wǒ de huà zhòng yào hái shi nǐ shǒu lǐ nà kuài tiě pái zhòng yào tài hòu lěng xiào dào
sentences.english: “Is what I’m saying important, or is that piece of metal in your hand more important?” the empress dowager sneered.

sentences.simplified: “这是皇上的令牌！”包拯大声说。
sentences.traditional: “這是皇上的令牌！”包拯大聲說。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì huáng shang de lìng pái bāo zhěng dà shēng shuō
sentences.english: “This is the emperor’s token!” Bao Zheng spoke loudly.

sentences.simplified: “是又怎么样……”太后冷笑，但她的话被一声“母亲”打断了，
sentences.traditional: “是又怎麼樣……”太后冷笑，但她的話被一聲“母親”打斷了，
sentences.pinyin: shì yòu zěn me yàng tài hòu lěng xiào dàn tā de huà bèi yì shēng mǔ qīn dǎ duàn le
sentences.english: “So what …” the empress dowager sneered, but her words were interrupted by a voice saying “Mother”.

sentences.simplified: 在包拯刚刚走来的那条路上，一个人正快步走来。
sentences.traditional: 在包拯剛剛走來的那條路上，一個人正快步走來。
sentences.pinyin: zài bāo zhěng gāng gang zǒu lái de nà tiáo lù shang yí ge rén zhèng kuài bù zǒu lái
sentences.english: On the very path where Bao Zheng had just walked, a person was now approaching quickly.

sentences.simplified: 他的身后也跟着一群宫女和太监，来人是皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 他的身後也跟著一群宮女和太監，來人是皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shēn hòu yě gēn zhe yì qún gōng nǚ hé tài jiàn lái rén shì huáng dì
sentences.english: A group of palace maids and eunuchs followed behind him. It was the emperor.

sentence_translations: Chapter 26: The Empress Dowager’s Sneer
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce came out of the Cold Palace and immediately rushed to the empress dowager’s palace to arrest Zhang Huai.
In the cold wind, a row of sword-bearing guards stood at the entrance of the empress dowager’s palace.
They seemed to know that Bao Zheng was coming and had already prepared.
Bao Zheng was startled and quickly said to Gongsun Ce, ..
.. “Go find Wei Ning and have him immediately go to the Cold Palace to protect Lan Xiang!”
Worried that there might be more problems, Bao Zheng also said, “We must also immediately protect Wang Tie east of the city!
Wei Ning must go personally. No one in the palace can be trusted right now.”
Gongsun Ce looked at the guards at the entrance of the empress dowager’s palace and understood.
He asked in surprise, “How did they know we were coming? Could it be … that someone is following us?”
Bao Zheng nodded and said, “They probably already know where we went, who we met, and what we said.
It’s my fault, I should have realized that this is the imperial palace, the empress dowager’s home, ..
.. and every person in the palace could be working for the empress dowager.”
“Then Lan Xiang is in danger! I’m leaving! Take care of yourself!” Gongsun Ce left in a hurry.
As soon as Gongsun Ce left, there was a commotion at the entrance of the empress dowager’s palace.
A group of palace maids and eunuchs helped someone walk out. It was the empress dowager.
The empress dowager stood in front of the guards, looking at Bao Zheng from a distance. Her expression was very cold.
Zhang Huai stood by her side, gently holding her hand.
“Bao Zheng, have you come to see me?” the empress dowager asked.
Bao Zheng bowed and replied, ..
.. “Empress Dowager, I am here to make an arrest. Chief Eunuch Zhang Huai has committed the crimes of murder and arson.”
“Who did he kill? What fire did he start?” The empress dowager’s tone did not change at all.
“Twenty-one years ago, he started a great fire in the Cold Palace, killing a guard and several palace maids, as well as a newborn child.”
“Do you have evidence?”
“I have a witness.”
“The crazy and foolish palace maid from the Cold Palace? You want to use a mentally unstable person as a witness?”
Bao Zheng was startled. His suspicions were indeed correct.
When he and Gongsun Ce went to the Cold Palace to see Lan Xiang, there really was someone following them.
“It seems you already know. Can you tell me what happened that night twenty-one years ago?” Bao Zheng asked.
Unlike her reaction when the events of twenty-one years ago were brought up the day before, ..
.. the empress dowager now appeared calm and composed, without a hint of nervousness.
She sneered, “I have nothing to say to you. But if you’re here to arrest Zhang Huai, I can tell you, that’s out of the question.”
Bao Zheng took out the emperor’s token, held it high in front of him and said, “I’m sorry, but I must take Zhang Huai away today.”
“Is what I’m saying important, or is that piece of metal in your hand more important?” the empress dowager sneered.
“This is the emperor’s token!” Bao Zheng spoke loudly.
“So what …” the empress dowager sneered, but her words were interrupted by a voice saying “Mother”.
On the very path where Bao Zheng had just walked, a person was now approaching quickly.
A group of palace maids and eunuchs followed behind him. It was the emperor.
